content_sections.heading: About Amrita
content_sections.text: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham is a university with campuses that include Amaravati, Amritapuri, Bengaluru, Chennai, Coimbatore, Faridabad, Haridwar, Kochi, Mysuru and Nagercoil. These posts are in the School of Computing at its Amaravati Campus.

content_sections.heading: Amrita Assistant Professor Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Any Degree of Computer Science related. Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a closely related discipline from a recognized university. Demonstrated excellence in research with publications in reputed journals and conferences. Strong commitment to high-quality teaching and student mentoring. Ability to teach core and specialized courses in computer science and engineering. Excellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills. Potential for securing research funding and collaborative projects. Research expertise in areas such as Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Cybersecurity, Software Engineering, Computer Networks, Systems, or other emerging fields. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility for this post.

content_sections.heading: Job Description
content_sections.text: The university is seeking a dynamic and motivated individual to contribute to teaching and research. The successful candidate will: Teach undergraduate and graduate courses. Conduct high-quality research. Mentor students. Participate in departmental and university activities.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Amrita Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the Amrita Assistant Professor job page . Select the Apply Online option on that page. Send any questions about the post to [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. Is a Ph.D. required for this post?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice asks for a Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a closely related discipline from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q2. What research record does Amrita ask for?
faq.answer: Candidates need demonstrated excellence in research, with publications in reputed journals and conferences.

faq.question: Q3. Which research areas does the notice mention?
faq.answer: It names Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Cybersecurity, Software Engineering, Computer Networks and Systems, and also allows other emerging fields.

faq.question: Q4. What will an Assistant Professor teach?
faq.answer: The appointee will handle undergraduate and graduate courses and should be able to teach core and specialized courses in computer science and engineering.

faq.question: Q5. Does the job include work beyond teaching?
faq.answer: Yes. It also involves high-quality research, student mentoring, and departmental and university activities.

faq.question: Q6. Does the notice mention research funding?
faq.answer: Yes. It lists the potential to secure research funding and collaborative projects among the skills and competencies.

faq.question: Q7. Whom can I contact about this recruitment?
faq.answer: The contact email printed in the notice is [email protected].
